subject: Demo takeaways + proposed 3-week validation sprint for AuricData
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@auricdata.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@auricdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — demo recap & quick next-step proposal

Hi Elena / Samir,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really valuable session. Quick recap from our side and a concrete next step so we keep momentum: 

TL;DR: we propose a 3-week validation sprint (POC-lite) focused on the two priority workflows you showed: document ingestion + conversational summarization (use case A) and label/QA augmentation for analyst workflows (use case B). Goal is to validate accuracy thresholds and latency under your expected load (5–10 concurrent users, 3k tokens/session).

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Ingestion: you already have S3 pipelines and a nightly ETL; we can attach to the same bucket and use prefix-based incremental ingestion.
- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS is required for production. We can run the POC in our Dedicated preview with encrypted volumes.
- Metrics you care about: recall@top3 for retrieval, summary ROUGE-like score relative to analyst edits, median token latency <220ms at nominal load.

Proposed 3-week validation sprint (high-level):
Week 0 (kickoff, prep): data access, sample set, success-metric agreement, test account provisioning.
Week 1: ingestion & baseline integration (run canonical prompts, measure retrieval quality).
Week 2: iterate prompts, enable Redwood caching/batching, run load tests, collect qualitative feedback from analysts.
Week 3: final acceptance run, review results, decision checkpoint.

I attached a short POC outline and an editable mutual action plan with owners. If this looks good, can we lock the kickoff for Monday 23 Aug?

Next steps (quick asks):
1) Elena/Samir: confirm data access scope (S3 prefix) + expected sample size by EOD Thu (20 Aug).
2) AuricData: flag any required compliance artifacts we should prepare (SOC2 attestation copy, IP whitelist).
3) Redwood: we’ll share a runbook + temporary test keys and schedule a 30-min kickoff with CS/eng.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you’d prefer to review live.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
attachments: auricdata-poc-outline.pdf, auricdata-mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@auricdata.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@auricdata.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — demo recap & quick next-step proposal

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications and constraints from our side: 

1) Data scope: for the POC we can provide ~250GB of de-identified reports in S3 under s3://auricdata/poc/samples. We will provide IAM role with read-only and a presigned ingestion manifest.
2) Success criteria we suggest: recall@3 >= 82% for retrieval on a 200-sample test, and analyst acceptance rate (post-edit) >= 70% for summarization tasks. Will that map to the ROUGE-like score you mentioned?
3) Security artifacts: we can provide SOC2 Type 2 report and vendor security questionnaire; we need confirmation that Redwood can bring KMS key management into the Dedicated preview.
4) Timeline: Aug 23 kickoff is OK but can you shift the final acceptance to Sep 15 instead of Sep 13? That gives our team time around the Labor Day week.

We’re onboard — please confirm owners and any pre-kickoff access steps.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Data Products
AuricData

Elena — really appreciate the quick clarifications. Short responses inline below and an updated timeline proposal attached.

1) Data scope: perfect — that s3 prefix works. Our ingestion team will request the IAM role ARN; please expect a request from eng@redwood within 24 hours.

2) Success criteria mapping: yes — your analyst acceptance rate target maps well to the summary ROUGE proxy we’ll compute and to a manual review sample. We’ll instrument both automated metrics (ROUGE-like) and a small human review of 100 cases to validate the proxy.

3) Security: Redwood can operate in a Dedicated preview with customer-managed KMS. For the POC we’ll provision a short-lived key that you control; our security team will send a checklist.

4) Timeline: OK to extend acceptance to 2027-09-15. I pushed the final acceptance to that date in the attached mutual action plan. Kickoff still Monday 2027-08-23 at 10:00am PT unless you prefer 2:00pm.

Owners (proposed):
- AuricData: Elena Rossi (POC sponsor), Samir Patel (data eng lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS lead), Ben Carter (solution eng), Vivek (engagement owner)

Attachments: updated POC outline (v1.1), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (owners + dates).

If that looks good I’ll send calendar invites and a short kickoff agenda.

Best,
Vivek
